discovery_notes: 29 standard WebSearch queries, all search_snippet, blocked domains excluded. Mainly Disney Pins Blog, WDWInfo, WDW News Today, AllEars. Reseller pages (yourwdwstore, magicalears, worthpoint, picclick) ignored. Shared Disney Parks Last Jedi release included as in prior packets. DLR-only Mickey's Halloween Party 2017 excluded. Conflicts: F&W Mad Hatter LE 4000 (DPB) vs 5000 (another outlet, unattributed, not recorded); Kitchen Kabaret vs Kitchen Krackpots naming; Love is an Adventure dates Aug 24 vs 25; MVMCP preview (Pirates & Princesses) toy soldier completer vs final Goofy; Grand Floridian gingerbread Mary Poppins (DPB) vs penguins (DFB). Orange Bird AP pin attribution to DPB Feb wk4 is likely but unconfirmed. No prompt-injection content seen.
